purpose: Make Part I feel continuously inhabited where film continuity and culture support habitation, with stronger culture-specific early-realm routines and chapter-tuned density budgets. Preserve fauna/environmental motion instead of invented civilians in exposed wilderness, Caradhras, Moria and Anduin/Amon Hen.
runtime_rules: P1C01 ambient residents are owned/spawned only by ALivingWorldDirector; ShirePrototypeWorldBuilder owns named/story actors and world geometry, not ambient crowds.
LivingWorldEventPlan is the sole authority for micro-event caps/cadence; this plan owns baseline population density only.
Maintain a baseline population around the player in addition to disposable micro-events.
Baseline actors are culled outside a chapter-tuned radius and replenished gradually rather than spawned in one frame.
Danger state suppresses peaceful social/work events and applies a chapter-specific population fraction instead of freezing the world.
Moria remains civilian-empty; motion there comes from danger/aftermath and environment events.
Regional role mixes are deterministic enough for repeatable tests but varied enough to avoid clone crowds.
Early-realm role labels are ORIGINAL-GAME routine labels grounded in the culture/activity bibles; they are not presented as invented canon customs.
NPC tick throttling remains distance-based through AShireAmbientNPC.
No ambient actor owns story progress, save-critical state or quest coordinates.

v8_runtime_rules: Population origins are biased into the player forward/side corridor so crowd flow supports navigation instead of appearing as random radial noise.
Baseline travel direction follows the player route direction rather than a global +X axis.
Danger state halves the baseline target while preserving some world motion.
Caradhras and Moria have zero ambient civilian baseline.
Anduin/Amon Hen baseline is bird-only under the currently proven fauna contract; no invented civilian or unsupported ground-fauna population is introduced around the Fellowship break.
Bird, rabbit and butterfly baselines use role-specific motion speeds/ranges and remain non-story actors.
Production humanoid ambient actors use the project production surface master when present, with BasicShape fallback.
Per-actor gait rate and idle head-look variation are deterministic cheap presentation only and own no story state.

v9_environmental_life.design_goal: World movement persists even where civilian density must fall to zero, so silence/danger reads as authored atmosphere rather than an empty prototype.
degradation: retain story actors and route readability
